title: Garmin Cadence vs Power Efficiency
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powermeter:ride
| stats avg(cadence_rpm) as avg_cadence_rpm avg(power_efficiency_pct) as avg_power_efficiency_pct by workout_name
| sort 0 - avg_cadence_rpm
description: Ranks workoutss by cadence and power efficiency.
value: Cadence plus efficiency helps you see which sessions are teaching good power delivery instead of just producing fatigue.
implementation: Send cadence and power efficiency events to `index=personal` and keep `workout_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of cadence and power efficiency by workouts.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which workoutss stand out most for cadence and power efficiency.
